```python
tools_list = await mcp.list_tools("tools")
```

```python
class Status(Enum):
    SUCCESS = auto()
    FAILURE = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()

class Node:
    def tick(self, world): raise NotImplementedError
    def halt(self): pass  # reset memory

class Leaf(Node):
    def __init__(self, name): self.name = name

class Condition(Leaf):
    def __init__(self, name, fn):
        super().__init__(name); self.fn = fn
    def tick(self, world):
        return Status.SUCCESS if self.fn(world) else Status.FAILURE

class Action(Leaf):
    def __init__(self, name, fn):
        super().__init__(name); self.fn = fn
    def tick(self, world):
        return self.fn(world)

class Decorator(Node): ...
class Inverter(Node):
    def __init__(self, child): self.child = child
    def tick(self, world):
        s = self.child.tick(world)
        if s == Status.SUCCESS: return Status.FAILURE
        if s == Status.FAILURE: return Status.SUCCESS
        return Status.RUNNING
    def halt(self): self.child.halt()

class Sequence(Node):
    def __init__(self, *children):
        self.children = list(children)
        self.index = 0
    def tick(self, world):
        while self.index < len(self.children):
            s = self.children[self.index].tick(world)
            if s == Status.RUNNING:
                return Status.RUNNING
            if s == Status.FAILURE:
                self.index = 0
                return Status.FAILURE
            self.index += 1
        self.index = 0
        return Status.SUCCESS
    def halt(self): self.index = 0; [c.halt() for c in self.children]

class Selector(Node): analogous with FAILURE/SUCCESS swapped.
```

Note: index retains running child across ticks → restart-from-running-child. When a child fails/succeeds mid-tick, continue within same tick (while loop).

```python
def test_selector_resumes_running_child_without_rerunning_earlier_siblings():
    probes = {"cond": 0}
    def running_twice(w):
        w["n"] += 1
        return Status.RUNNING if w["n"] < 3 else Status.SUCCESS
    tree = Selector(
        Condition("probe", lambda w: (probes.__setitem__("cond", probes["cond"]+1), True)[1]),
        Action("worker", running_twice),
        Action("fallback", lambda w: Status.SUCCESS),
    )
    world = {"n": 0}
    assert tree.tick(world) is Status.RUNNING
    assert probes["cond"] == 1
    assert tree.tick(world) is Status.RUNNING
    # cond NOT probed again
    assert probes["cond"] == 1
    assert world["n"] == 2
    assert tree.tick(world) is Status.SUCCESS
    assert world["n"] == 3
```

    1. intruder visible  -> chase (RUNNING while the intruder stays in sight;
                                if the intruder vanishes mid-chase, the chase

                                re-evaluates from the top next tick)
    2. at post           -> idle scan (one reactive SUCCESS scan per tick)
    3. not at post       -> walk back to post (RUNNING until arrival)

Scripted world, 12 ticks. The guard starts 2 steps away from its post.
The intruder appears at tick 4 and vanishes at tick 8 (i.e. is visible on

chase tick; walking home is -1 step per tick.
